name: Put the Mycelium contacts on the iPhone

definition.title: Put the Mycelium contacts on the iPhone ({{run}})
definition.body_md: Replace the iPhone's contacts with the Mycelium export (claude/people-contacts-spec.md C7). Five steps on icloud.com and the phone, about 15 minutes. Do the backup first — step 3 deletes everything on iCloud.

steps_definition.title: Put the Mycelium contacts on the iPhone

values.label: Five names to check on the phone afterwards

intro.verdict_html: Why delete first: iCloud adds on import and does not merge. Importing over the existing contacts would give every person two cards — one old, one from Mycelium. So: back up, empty iCloud, import once.
prerequisites: The People contacts smoke test passed (the export has the right numbers and no old ones)
Signed in to icloud.com on the PC with the same Apple ID as the iPhone
The iPhone is on Wi-Fi with iCloud Contacts turned on (Settings → your name → iCloud → Contacts)

phases.title: Back up, export, replace
phases.lede_html: Keep the backup file until the phone looks right for a week.

steps.title: Export the current contacts from icloud.com/contacts as a backup vCard: open icloud.com/contacts, click any contact, ⌘A / Ctrl+A to select all, the gear (⚙) → Export vCard…, save as icloud-backup-{{run}}.vcf somewhere safe (not in the repo)

fields.label: How many contacts iCloud said it exported

steps.title: Download the Mycelium export: People → EXPORT .VCF (this is tier=all: people and contacts, current numbers and emails only, deleted people excluded)

fields.label: Cards in the Mycelium file (search the file for BEGIN:VCARD)

steps.title: Delete all contacts on icloud.com: with all still selected, gear (⚙) → Delete, confirm. The list empties. (Why: iCloud adds on import and does not merge — importing over the old set would double everyone.)
Import the Mycelium .vcf on icloud.com: gear (⚙) → Import vCard…, pick the file from 1.2. iCloud reports how many it imported

fields.label: How many iCloud said it imported

steps.title: On the iPhone open Contacts, pull to refresh, wait a minute. The count at the bottom of the list matches 1.4. Open each of {{five}}: the right numbers, with their labels (a custom label like "Office direct" shows as typed), and no old numbers
